# D75 rating study evidence

The runtime retains D65. See ../../../RATING_VALIDATION_REPORT.md for both study results and ../../../RATING_VALIDATION_POLICY.md for the explicit post-result policy decision. The original exact-equality failure is preserved under original-calibration/; successor acceptance does not relabel it a pass.

These files archive the independently checked research run. Sources are exact copies of the separately frozen study scripts, not new runtime code or replacement expected outputs. Reports, all coefficient refits, paired population bootstrap totals and all 20,000 compact outcome records are retained here; gzip files decompress to the exact source bytes identified by INDEX.json. Detailed population reports include class and edge-side results, zero categories and age/XP coverage. No fixed-weight predictive bootstrap is described as coefficient fitting.

The complete workspace inputs, original independent reference, full fight transcripts, binary/toolchain records, failed preparation attempt and execution captures are retained in artifacts/set42/set42-d75-research.tar.gz outside this Git checkout. The separate verification report, set42-d75-research-verification.json, records both the archive and standalone manifest hashes. The source/input freeze and INDEX.json identify exact large artifacts; no artifact is silently regenerated to hide the original failure.

For reproduction, use an extracted working copy of the research archive with the sibling directories set42-rating-validation and set42-fight-reference. Preserve the original archive. The captured run used CPython 3.14.3 and the recorded Darwin arm64 compiler/binary; exact source pins and reviewed numerical cross-checks apply. Scripts use exclusive output creation and an explicit execution-release gate, so do not run them directly in this archival testdata directory or overwrite retained results. A rerun must use separate output state; a rebuilt accelerator or changed environment requires its own recorded freeze and numerical validation. This is a reproducible execution record, not a portable installer.

The source protocol and resource amendment fix the samples, predictors, resampling units, deadlines and interpretation. The only preparation amendment raised the global manifest-derivation cap after an outcome-free failure; all 14,151 prior input rows were reproduced exactly. The new observations were not used to tune the engine or select new weights.
